post_clip.description: A person exits a dark vehicle and appears to interact with the fuel pump or vehicle in a manner consistent with refueling, but then suddenly raises an object (possibly a container or device) near the pump while standing close to the open fuel door—this behavior is highly suspicious at a gas station at night and may indicate intent to ignite fuel or commit arson. No explosion occurs in the frames, but the actions are abnormal and high-risk: prolonged proximity to fuel source, unusual posture, and handling of unknown object near flammable environment. This constitutes suspicious activity warranting alarm.

A person is seen interacting with the open fuel filler area of a vehicle at a gas pump; in the final frames, the person appears to be crouching or falling abruptly near the vehicle's rear, possibly after an ignition event or sudden reaction—though no visible explosion (flash, debris, smoke cloud) occurs in these frames, the rapid posture change and proximity to fueling suggest high-risk abnormal behavior consistent with potential arson or accidental fire initiation. Given the context and expected anomaly type (explosion), this sequence is highly suspicious and deviates from normal refueling behavior.

Sudden ignition of fire at the rear of a vehicle next to a person at a gas pump; bright flame erupts instantly (frame 8), consistent with a fuel-related fire/explosion event—highly abnormal and dangerous.
